meaning: Construct distinct actual power and existence support relations over three beings and two universally accessible worlds. In both models a powered effect is inductively grounded in an unborrowed source. In the first the source is contingent and externally supported; in the second it is necessary, unsupported in the model, and composite. All represented causal/part relations hold among actually existing bearers.
